note: Roads chosen because they do NOT separate cleanly - the four curated archetypes in landcover_fixture.json separate by a wide margin only because they were picked to. Each way is sampled at four grid PHASES half a step apart; the land underneath is identical at every phase, so any movement in the fractions is a sampling artefact and nothing else.
